item.title: Can't Stop Thinking During Meditation? What to Do With a Busy Mind
item.description: Why your mind won't stop during meditation, and what to do about it. How to label thoughts and return to the breath, common mistakes, what research shows, and when to get help.

item.title: Schulte Table Focus Exercise: Find the Numbers in Order (Free, Online)
item.description: What a Schulte table is and how to use it as a short focus exercise. Steps, the rotating-rings version, common mistakes, and what research says about mental training games.

item.title: 2-Minute Breathing Exercise: 3 Quick Ways to Calm Down and Reset
item.description: A 2-minute breathing exercise for a quick mental reset. Three short techniques (coherent breathing, long exhale, physiological sigh), when to use each, and what the research shows.

item.title: A Mindful Check-In Every 2 Hours: A Simple Chime Practice
item.description: A simple daily practice: every two hours a soft chime reminds you to pause, ask yourself one short question and choose your state of mind for 30 seconds. Includes how to set a 2-hour chime in Calm.

item.title: 4-7-8 Breathing: How to Do It, How Many Rounds, and What the Research Says
item.description: How to do the 4-7-8 breathing technique step by step, how many rounds to start with, common mistakes, who should be careful, how it compares to box breathing and what studies show.

item.title: Where Do You Feel Emotions in Your Body? Body Maps of Emotions and a Body Scan Practice
item.description: A study of over 700 people found that each emotion has its own pattern in the body. Learn what the bodily maps of emotions show, what they don't, and try a 10-minute body scan.

item.title: 10-Minute Ocean Sounds Meditation on a Moonlit Sea
item.description: A ready-to-play 10-minute meditation with ocean wave sounds and a moving moonlit sea in the background. Start with one click; free and no sign-up.

item.title: 10-Minute Space Meditation with the 52 Hz Whale Song
item.description: Ten quiet minutes with a slowly spinning galaxy and the song of the 52 Hz whale in the background. A ready-to-play meditation that starts with one click; free, no sign-up.

item.title: Box Breathing: How to Do the 4-4-4-4 Technique, Step by Step
item.description: A step-by-step guide to box breathing (4-4-4-4 or square breathing): inhale, hold, exhale and pause for four seconds each. Includes a free guided exercise.

item.title: How to Meditate for Beginners: What Meditation Is, and a 5-Minute First Practice
item.description: What is meditation, really? A beginner's guide to how to meditate, the main types, a step-by-step 5-minute practice, common mistakes and what the research actually shows.
